verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software agent or AI client. Plugging MCP servers into it so it can use their tools is a category error. Its documented internal use of AI contract-review legaltech is not MCP-client functionality, so the axis does not apply.
